How much does it cost to develop an app like Gojek?

Reapmind Innovations / November 22, 2023

Introduction:

Have you ever wished for a single app that could seamlessly bring you a ride, or your favorite meal, deliver a package, and entertain you all in one place?

The app-based service market is worth billions globally, with India experiencing an explosive rise in this sector.

In a world where convenience is key, apps like Gojek have redefined how we access services. From transportation and food delivery to digital payments, Gojek’s multi-service ecosystem has set a new standard. Gojek has not just created an app; it has revolutionized how people access services in Southeast Asia.

In this blog, let’s dive into the world of multi-service apps and unravel how Gojek makes money, what fuels its success, and what goes into the cost of building a similar app.

Understanding Gojek

Gojek, headquartered in Jakarta, Indonesia, has undergone a significant transformation since its establishment in 2009. Originally started as a call center connecting consumers with courier delivery and ride-hailing services, Gojek has evolved into a versatile super app.

What makes Gojek unique is its integrated approach, offering a wide array of services—more than 20—on a single platform. This approach simplifies users’ lives by allowing them to access transportation, food delivery, logistics, and digital payments all in one place.

Gojek’s expansive reach across five countries and its valuation of US$10 billion, designating it as a “Decacorn,” marks its influence in the tech industry. The app has been downloaded nearly 190 million times, and in 2019, it made a significant contribution of over $7 billion to the Indonesian economy.

Gojek’s success extends beyond mere innovation; it has played a pivotal role in shaping a new way of life in Southeast Asia, serving as a prime example for those interested in developing a similar multi-service super app.

Features offered by the Gojek app

  1. Real-Time Tracking: Users can track the location and progress of their service providers or deliveries in real time.
  2. Secure Payment Gateway: Gojek provides secure and convenient payment options, including credit and debit cards, digital wallets, and in-app payments.
  3. User and Service Provider Profiles: Users can create profiles with personal information, while service providers can showcase their offerings and qualifications.
  4. Reviews and Ratings: Both users and service providers can leave and view reviews and ratings, fostering transparency and trust.
  5. In-App Chat Support: The app includes a chat feature for communication between users and service providers, ensuring smooth interactions.
  6. Multi-Service Platform: Gojek integrates a wide range of services into a single app for user convenience.
  7. Customization: Users can customize their experience by choosing from various services and personalizing their preferences.
  8. Promotions and Discounts: Gojek offers special promotions and discounts for users, enhancing cost-effectiveness.
  9. Language and Currency Options: The app supports multiple languages and currency options for a global user base.
  10. Safety Features: Gojek prioritizes user safety with features like driver verification, emergency buttons, and real-time SOS alerts.
  11. Multi-Platform Access: Users can access Gojek services through mobile apps on both iOS and Android devices.
  12. Rewards and Loyalty Programs: Gojek may offer rewards and loyalty programs to incentivize user engagement and usage.
  13. Weather Information: The app may provide weather updates, particularly important for transportation and delivery services.
  14. Scheduled Services: Users can schedule services for a later time, ensuring timely delivery or pick-up.
  15. Interactive Maps: Gojek utilizes maps to show nearby service providers and facilitate location-based searches.
  16. Multi-Device Compatibility: The Gojek app can be used across various devices, including smartphones and tablets.

Gojek Business Model:

Gojek’s success story is intricately linked to its adoption of the super-app business model, which brings a wide array of services under a single digital roof. In a world where time is of the essence, this approach offers an unparalleled level of convenience.

By understanding the inner workings of the Gojek super app, we can gain valuable perspectives on both its revenue generation and the factors influencing the cost of developing a similar multi-service platform.

Key Takeaway Points:

  • Super App Simplicity: Gojek’s super app model simplifies the lives of consumers by offering a one-stop solution for various services, from booking movie tickets to sending packages, saving time, and providing a streamlined experience.
  • Three Key Segments: Gojek’s business model centers around three core segments: consumers, merchants, and drivers, each playing a unique role in the platform’s operations and success.
  • Consumer-Centric Experience: Gojek ensures consumers can effortlessly choose, order, and pay for services within the app, offering a seamless experience for a multitude of needs.
  • Merchant Integration: Merchants efficiently process orders they receive through the Gojek app, while payments are streamlined through the GoPay wallet.
  • Driver Engagement: Drivers sign up with Gojek, select the services they wish to provide, and accept orders through the app. The app’s flexibility ensures orders are efficiently managed, even when drivers are occupied.

 

Gojek Revenue Model:

With a diverse range of offerings and a valuation that has earned it the title of “Indonesian Unicorn,” Gojek’s success is a testament to its innovative business model. But what fuels this impressive financial growth? Let’s explore the key revenue-generating strategies that have allowed Gojek to ascend the ranks and understand how these insights play a pivotal role in estimating the cost of developing a similar app.

Key Takeaway Points:

  • Commission on Services: Gojek earns a significant portion of its revenue through service fees. Users pay a fee for the convenience and range of services available on the platform.
  • Commission from Vendors: By partnering with a multitude of vendors and merchants, Gojek extends its reach and charges these businesses a commission on each order or booking made through the platform.
  • Commission from Drivers: The network of delivery providers also contributes to Gojek’s revenue. While offering incentives and benefits, Gojek charges a nominal fee to these service providers.

Factors Influencing Gojek App Development Cost:

Developing an app like Gojek comes with a range of cost factors that can significantly impact the overall budget. Let’s delve into the key factors that play a pivotal role in determining the cost of developing an app like Gojek.

  1. App Features and Functionality: The extensive list of services offered by Gojek, such as ride-hailing, food delivery, and digital payments, directly impacts development costs. Each feature requires time and resources, with more comprehensive features leading to higher expenses.
  2. Technology Stack and Infrastructure: The choice of technology stack and infrastructure influences costs. Utilizing the latest technologies and ensuring scalability and security adds to the budget. These investments are crucial for long-term success.
  3. Development Team Expertise: The expertise of the development team is vital. Skilled professionals with experience in multi-service app development streamline the process, potentially reducing costs in the long run.
  4. App Design and User Experience: The cost of graphic design, UI, and UX design depends on complexity and quality. A well-designed app attracts users and enhances their experience, contributing to the app’s overall success.  

Cost Factors for Gojek-Like App Development:

Estimating the Gojek App Development Cost:

According to a recent survey of Gojek app developers, the average cost of developing a Gojek-like app with all of the features and functionality of the original app is approximately $200,000. However, the cost can vary depending on factors such as the experience and location of the development team, the complexity of the app’s design and development, and the timeline for development.

For a basic app with limited features, anticipate a minimum investment of $100,000. However, for a comprehensive Gojek-like app with all the functionalities of the original, the investment can range up to $350,000 approximately.

However, the cost can vary depending on factors such as the experience and location of the development team, the complexity of the app’s design and development, and the timeline for development.

Development Team Expenses:

  • Developers: $40,000–$120,000 per year
  • UI/UX Designers: $30,000-$80,000 per year
  • Project Managers: $60,000–$100,000 per year
  • QA Testers: $30,000-$80,000 per year

Development Timeline: Your app’s creation journey will take around 9–12 months. This timeframe is influenced by the complexity of your project, which affects how much time and resources you’ll need.

Maintenance and Support: After launching your app, set aside $20,000–$50,000 each month. This money is for ongoing support, making sure your app keeps improving, fixing bugs, and helping users have a smooth experience.

Additional Considerations: Choosing where your app works costs $20,000–$50,000 per platform. Fancy features also affect costs, shaping how well your app works.

Marketing and Promotion: To get your app noticed and keep users interested, plan to spend $10,000–$50,000 on ads and promotions, both at the start and continuously.

Regional Cost Breakdown:

Understanding that development costs can vary globally, here’s a regional breakdown:

  • United States: $250,000–$350,000
  • Western Europe: $200,000-$300,000
  • Eastern Europe: $150,000–$250,000
  • Asia: $100,000-$200,000

FAQ’s

What is Gojek, and how does it work?

Gojek is a multi-service on-demand platform that offers various services like ride-hailing, food delivery, couriering, and more. Users can access these services through a mobile app.

What is the cost of developing an app like Gojek?

The cost of developing an app like Gojek can vary significantly based on features, complexity, technology stack, and the development team’s location. It can range from $100,000 to several million dollars.

 What factors influence the development cost of a Gojek-like app?

The development cost is influenced by features, platforms (iOS, Android), design complexity, third-party integrations, the location of the development team, and ongoing maintenance.

How does Gojek make money?

Gojek generates revenue through various channels, including commissions from service providers, advertising, subscription models, and transaction fees. They also explore partnerships and collaborations to boost their income.

Can I use an existing app template to build a Gojek-like app and save on development costs?

While using existing templates can save time, it’s essential to customize and enhance the app to match your unique business requirements. A tailored solution is often a better choice for long-term success.
